requirements.title: CFI error indicators distinguish success from detected standard errors
requirements.definition: For functions in 18.5.5 that return an error indicator, zero indicates no error condition was detected, a nonzero value indicates the detected error condition, and Table 18.5 supplies standard error conditions and macro names.

pending.cfi-error-indicator-zero-success: C companion includes ISO_Fortran_binding.h, establishes a rank-one descriptor for int storage with extent 3, calls CFI_establish, and asserts the returned indicator equals CFI_SUCCESS and CFI_SUCCESS equals integer zero.
pending.cfi-error-indicator-nonzero-detected-err: C source-control companion calls CFI_establish with rank CFI_MAX_RANK plus one under a diagnostic profile; an accepted detected standard condition is compared to CFI_INVALID_RANK by macro identity and no numeric value is asserted.
pending.cfi-standard-error-macro-names: Header-only C companion uses preprocessor and static assertions for CFI_SUCCESS, CFI_ERROR_BASE_ADDR_NULL, CFI_ERROR_BASE_ADDR_NOT_NULL, CFI_INVALID_ELEM_LEN, CFI_INVALID_RANK, CFI_INVALID_TYPE, CFI_INVALID_ATTRIBUTE, CFI_INVALID_EXTENT, CFI_INVALID_DESCRIPTOR, CFI_ERROR_MEM_ALLOCATION, and CFI_ERROR_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, with only CFI_SUCCESS fixed to zero and nonzero distinctness for the rest owned by 18.5.4.

requirements.title: Processors have latitude for additional and competing CFI error detections
requirements.definition: A processor is permitted to detect error conditions beyond the standard list, and selection of one detected condition is processor dependent for an invocation capable of detecting more than one.

pending.processor-may-detect-other-cfi-errors: No portable oracle requires an implementation to expose an extra error condition or fixes the macro value used for one; future fixtures only accept documented processor-profile behavior for this latitude.
pending.multiple-cfi-error-choice-processor-depe: No portable oracle may choose between two simultaneously detectable errors; future invalid-call probes isolate one invalid property or compare only membership in the named standard-error set.

requirements.title: CFI subscript-like argument arrays follow descriptor dimension order
requirements.definition: Function arguments representing subscripts, bounds, extents, or strides use the same element ordering as the dim member of a C descriptor.

pending.cfi-argument-arrays-dim-order: C companion establishes a rank-two descriptor over int storage with extents 3 and 4, passes lower, upper, stride, and subscript arrays whose first element selects descriptor dimension 0 and second element selects dimension 1, then verifies CFI_address and CFI_section select the element sequence predicted from dim[0] and dim[1] storage strides.
